frontMatter.title: Joint integration record: the final real Maestro/Mega-Maestro pair (MRC-12-06, incomplete)

summary: The final real pair was driven again on 2026-10-25 with the library rebuilt from HEAD a112e9736 (maestro-lib 0.24.0, index.js f08ea73d) against the only Mega-Maestro endpoint source on this host, the development checkout at d5143a63 (dirty, 935 entries, endpoint built 2026-10-19; labeled with --allow-dirty), inside the pinned Linux harness image. The daemon started, attached as unenrolled, and every one of the five journeys ended before any lease: attach and compatibility denied unauthenticated, the registration challenge unavailable (no approval producer), execution and workflow admission runtime-unavailable, the desktop admission denied unauthenticated. Zero leases, zero effects, exit 3 by design. The record separates three claims: Maestro code is complete for every owned task of the twelve phases (all implementation, test and verify boxes except this one are checked; see the per-phase evidence); joint integration is NOT verified, because the three cross-project producers (CP-01 fresh contracts and clean packaged artifacts, CP-02 a supported createMaestroAdapter, CP-03 an authenticated delegation/workflow authority) and the registration-approval producer are absent, so no required acceptance row passed against the real pair; production qualification is not implied by anything here. Twelve of thirteen required rows are not passed; the thirteenth (standalone) passed for what it demonstrates on this host. This task stays unchecked.

Focused suites, type checks and builds for phase 12 are recorded in evidence/12-standalone.md (469 files, 9153 passed, 0 failed, 14 skipped with each gate recorded).
